producer_report.summary: Added the shared records-history cutover fixture. It is `athena_core::test_support` (compiled for tests and the off-by-default `test-support` feature, which only the cli dev-dependency enables). `CutoverFixture::build` makes a work repo and a bare remote, then runs through Athena's real writers: a bootstrap commit; one old-way job read, dispatched, verified and landed by `ask` and `go` with trailers; then the cutover job, which sets `[history] cutover_job` and is landed through the public `gh::land_pr` with the real records sink, remote and content check. Only the host is faked. That writes the landing intent, landing record, import with manifest and legacy-exempt record. The cli `tests/common/mod.rs` has `cutover_fixture()` and `athena_check()`. `tests/cutover_fixture.rs` has 4 tests that pin the shape and run the real `athena check --history` and `athena check --attribution` (both pass). Docs are in the module text, the CHANGELOG and a new D120 in docs/decisions.md. No production code changed. fmt, clippy and the full test suite pass.

checks_run.note: exit status 0; the full log was too large to read back, so the pass rests on the exit status

criteria_check.criterion: A test using the helper runs `athena check --history` and `athena check --attribution` on the fixture's main and both report no violations; run `cargo test` and see it pass.
criteria_check.evidence: cutover_fixture.rs the_history_and_attribution_checks_pass_on_the_fixtures_main runs the real athena binary (athena_check) in the fixture work repo, asserts exit 0, '0 violation(s)', 'attribution pass' and '0 finding(s)'. Passed in cargo test -p athena-cli --test cutover_fixture and in cargo test --locked.

criteria_check.criterion: A test asserts the old-way landing commit carries its Athena trailers, produced through the real landing path (not hand-built commit text), and that the job was read, dispatched, verified and landed.
criteria_check.evidence: the_old_way_job_landed_with_its_trailers_and_was_read_dispatched_and_verified asserts Athena-Job and Athena-Verified-Content on the landing made by Athena::go, ancestry from the bootstrap, and Records::load shows a reading, a candidate, a Pass verification and JobState::Closed(Landed). Passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A test asserts C0 resolves from the cutover job's landing record on athena/records, and that the import commit and legacy-exempt record exist there; the import manifest self-check passes.
criteria_check.evidence: c0_resolves_from_the_cutover_landing_and_the_import_and_exempt_record_are_on_the_records_branch uses cutover_commit_at on the bare remote's records tip, checks the import commit's parent is the landing record commit, calls verify_cutover_import, parses import-manifest.json and legacy-exempt.json, and checks the cutover warning. Passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The fixture has a bare remote, a bootstrap commit, and [history] cutover_job names the cutover job; `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` pass.
criteria_check.evidence: the_fixture_has_a_bare_remote_a_bootstrap_commit_and_names_the_cutover_job asserts rev-parse --is-bare-repository is true, remote main equals local main, the root is the bootstrap commit with Athena-Job: bootstrap, and cutover_job_for(main) equals the cutover job id. cargo test --locked, clippy -D warnings and fmt --check all exit 0.

criteria_check.criterion: The helper has doc comments (and a CHANGELOG.md entry) explaining its shape and how the trailer job and job 7 part 2 should reuse it from both athena-core and athena-cli tests.
criteria_check.evidence: test_support.rs module doc has 'The shape of the history' and 'Reusing it' sections naming athena-cli (cutover_fixture, athena_check) and athena-core (CutoverSpec) use; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Added entry names both later jobs; D120 added to docs/decisions.md.

criteria_check.criterion: No production behavior changes: no edits to run.rs, gh.rs, land.rs, or gate code; the fixture is test-only and compiled only for tests.
criteria_check.evidence: git status shows changes only to the two Cargo.toml files, athena-core lib.rs (one cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support")) pub mod line plus a doc line), cli tests/common/mod.rs, new test_support.rs and cutover_fixture.rs, CHANGELOG.md and decisions.md. The feature is off by default and only the cli dev-dependency enables it.

open_issues: crates/athena-cli/Cargo.toml was edited (dev-dependency athena-core with feature test-support); it is not in the brief's deliverables but is needed for cli tests to see the module.
The brief listed test_support.rs as modify; it did not exist, so it was created.
Core tests that reuse the fixture must pass their own capabilities and scripts in a CutoverSpec; whether athena-cap-change can be a core dev-dependency was not checked.
The fake host's squash message is title and body only, without the '(#n)' suffix a real host adds.
The full-suite pass rests on the exit status; the log was too large to read back.
Each fixture build takes about 5 to 10 seconds; the four tests each build their own.
mistakes: Earlier drafts had an unused capabilities field on CutoverFixture and a doc reference to a method that did not exist; both were fixed before the final run.
learnings: Admission refuses a change to athena.toml unless the accepted reading lists it as a deliverable and an acceptance criterion names it.

go's local landing commit sits behind the job's own record commits (proposal, prediction), so its parent is not the bootstrap commit and candidate.base_commit is not the bootstrap; use ancestry checks.

The cutover needs a non-empty [history] exempt list whose entries have known reasons; a fixture's exempt list must equal the built-in one or the history check flags the commit that adds entries not yet in history.
check --attribution runs the part-1 walk from the earliest intent's expected base; with the cutover shown, check --history uses check_after_cutover.
Athena::resync_onto_merge is public and moves local main onto the host squash commit, as athena land --pr does.
gh::land_pr is public and takes trait objects, so the real flow can be driven with only a fake PrHost; ask/go need a capability, which core lacks, so callers pass them.
desires: A way to read a persisted large tool output inside the working directory, to confirm per-binary test results of the full suite.
A note in the brief on whether athena-cli/Cargo.toml may be edited for a dev-dependency.
